about: v1.1α の比較元のバイトの記録の経路の定義（Issue #546）。確定した仕様・応答・偽物の判定の答えはすべて合成（抽象的な題材。凍結した組・本物の応答の写しは使わない）。手で直さない。

base.source: 項目を題名・金額・日付・区分・担当者つきで登録できる。担当者の名前と担当する項目の数、項目の題名を一覧で見られる。金額が 0 より大きい項目だけを締められる。区分ごとの件数と月ごとの金額の合計、全体の率をまとめの画面で見られる。

output.declaration:
entities:
  - name: member
    fields:
      title:
        type: string
  - name: item
    fields:
      title:
        type: string
      owner:
        type: ref
        to: member
      amount:
        type: number
      day:
        type: date
      kind:
        type: enum
        options:
          alpha: アルファ
          beta: ベータ
computed:
  - name: itemCount
    entity: member
    aggregate:
      count: item
      where:
        owner: this
    type: number
  - name: base
    scope: app
    aggregate:
      sum: item.amount
    type: number
  - name: rate
    scope: app
    expression: base * 2
    type: number
  - name: byKind
    aggregate:
      count: item
      groupBy: item.kind
    type: groups
  - name: byMonth
    aggregate:
      sum: item.amount
      groupBy:
        month: item.day
      last: 6
    type: groups
views:
  - name: items
    type: table
    entity: item
    show: [title, owner, amount, day, kind]
  - name: members
    type: table
    entity: member
    show: [title, itemCount]
  - name: overview
    type: dashboard
    widgets:
      - type: number
        value: rate
      - type: number
        value: base
      - type: bar
        value: byMonth
      - type: pie
        value: byKind
actions:
  - name: addItem
    entity: item
  - name: closeItem
    entity: item
    kind: update
    set:
      kind: beta
    when: amount > 0
validations:
  - name: amount
    entity: item
    expression: amount > 0
permissions:
  - name: read
    subject: minIdentity
  - name: write
    subject: minIdentity
minIdentity:
  mode: anonymous
